title: Momoi Airi — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just one minute away from tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm sure the messages will come flooding in at exactly—
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Airi! Let's hang out and go shopping together sometime—when you're not busy with idol stuff of course!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, oh Ena. It's not my birthday yet.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I bet she wanted to be the first one to wish me a happy birthday and pressed send a little too early.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ah, it's midnight!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Airi! I can't wait to get celebrating in our special livestream later today♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Good morning, Airi! Aaand...happy birthday♪ Looking forward to watching your birthday stream later!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Airi! Rest assured that I'll be there to help you make today's livestream an exciting one.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Also, I know you're probably getting a lot of messages right now, so don't worry about replying to me.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As if I would agree to that! Let's see, I'll reply to Ena first—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Airi! I'm always wishing you a happy birthday! I'll make sure you have an absolutely wonderful day.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, what do you mean, “always”? That's a Minori-level mistake...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh? My phone flashed...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Airi! Good morning!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, if it isn't Rin! What are you doing staying up this late?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehehe, on behalf of everyone in SEKAI, I'm here to pay you a visit on your special day♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you, Rin! I'm so happy that you came to see me like this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh no, I'm glad that I got the chance to say happy birthday♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Since it was too late for all of us to visit, we decided to hold a rock paper scissors championship to decide who would go.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So I'm the lucky one who gets to celebrate with the grand champ Rin, huh. Maybe some of that luck will rub off on me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, looks like I got another message.
Oh, wait...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Whoa, was it really that funny? Can I see?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Here...
Hehe, you better brace yourself for this one.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Awesome! Oh, it looks like an idol group photo...huh?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Haha! What is this? Everyone's pulling silly faces!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ahhh, they managed to make me laugh this year, too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The girls in this picture are from my old idol group, QT.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even after I left the group, they never fail to send me birthday wishes—with silly group selfies, too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I bet it's their way of reminding me to fill my days with fun and making me laugh while they're at it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <They sound like lovely people if they'd keep sending you birthday wishes even after you left.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, they really are...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When times get tough, or I need a pick-me-up, looking at those silly selfies they send me makes me feel better.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, I see. Then you better tell them you're doing fine♪>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I have a feeling today's going to be super fun!)
song00004_off_f
Rental Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ready, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's time for Airi's Special Birthday Livestream♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's get this party started!

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yippee! It's finally time!>
<Happy bday, Airi!>
<You're the best! I love you!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa, whoa, whoa! I knew there'd be lots of comments, but not this many! Look at them go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um... “Airi, happy...”, “thanks for...”, “you're my favorite...”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, they're too fast to read.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you all for your birthday wishes! I'll make sure to read them all later, so stay tuned♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay! Since it's my birthday, how about I kick things off with a song?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright! I'll get ready!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Huh? She's singing live?!>
<Yay! What're you gonna sing?>
<A surprise song?! I'm gonna faint!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's an original song that we performed at our solo show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Exactly. But this time...
Airi will be performing a solo rendition of it!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Solo?!>
<Whoa, now I can tick this off my bucket list.>
<I'm listening.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi said she wanted to surprise you fans with something as a thank you for all your support, so she's been rehearsing for quite a while now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah. When I heard her practice, she was so captivating that she left me speechless.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why, what a lovely compliment.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your patience!
I'm ready to go!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That's what she wore during the solo show!>
<Whoa, she looks amazing!>
<Thank you so much for this!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alrighty, let's raise the roof!
Lemme hear it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And what about you guys?

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is everyone on the livestream ready?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah♪>
<Woohoo! Yay♪>
<Yeah!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't believe we've reached the end of the stream already.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but I performed the song, we got to talk a lot, and loads of our viewers joined in on the chat. It was so fun.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I had loads of fun, too!>
<I wish we could have a birthday stream every day.>
<Your solo rendition was amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like our viewers had lots of fun.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <Are you guys gonna go celebrate after the stream?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, we are! We're going to get together with friends and go all out!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That sounds great!>
<Let your hair down!>
<Airi, thank you so much for putting on this livestream!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm the one who should be saying thank you. From the bottom of my heart, thank you to all of you for watching.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I couldn't be happier to have so many lovely fans like you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I promise to give my all every day as a member of MORE MORE JUMP! I hope you'll continue to support me♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And that's it from me, Airi Momoi♪
This has been one special delivery of love!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I'll support you for the rest of my life!>
<Love you Airi!>
<Girl, you got this!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you for today!
